scenarios.name: Align the model browser and viewport to the workspace frame

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the model browser is docked at the left
the user inspects the workspace boundaries
the model browser begins at the left content edge directly below the ribbon
the viewport begins at the browser's shared divider without an empty gutter
the viewport fills the remaining content width
the ribbon, browser, viewport and status area use aligned outer edges
